prompt: Aerial drone photo of the Damyang Metasequoia Road in Korea in late autumn, the famous long straight avenue lined with giant metasequoia trees turned deep copper and orange. The trees have grown 150 meters tall and bent inward from both sides, their branches weaving together into a closed living tunnel of red-brown foliage that swallows the entire road, fallen needles flooding the ground, tiny visitors on bicycles and on foot at the mouth of the tunnel looking up, soft golden morning light.

Aerial drone photo of Cheomseongdae observatory in Gyeongju, Korea, at sunset in autumn. The pink muhly grass field around it has exploded into a 200 meter tall rising cloud of pink and magenta grass, billowing upward like pink smoke and curling over the ancient stone tower, swallowing it, pink strands drifting through the air, the green lawns and tiny tourists in hanbok below looking up, warm orange sky.

Aerial drone photo of Saebyeol Oreum volcanic hill on Jeju Island, Korea, covered in silver autumn pampas grass. The grass has become an enormous 120 meter tall ocean wave made of glowing silver and gold grass, curling and about to break over the summit of the hill, grass spraying from its crest, tiny hikers on the ridge trail looking back at it, flat farmland and the sea in the distance, low golden sunset light.

Aerial drone photo of the Gokgyocheon ginkgo tree road in Asan, Korea, in peak autumn, the long path lined with bright yellow ginkgo trees along the stream. The fallen yellow ginkgo leaves have become a river: a 40 meter wide torrent of golden leaves flowing down the path like water, pouring over the edge of a bridge and cascading into the stream below as a leaf waterfall, tiny visitors wading knee deep in leaves, clear blue autumn sky.
